_help: Key = server name (with the Hetzner API: the name in the Hetzner console). ssh = an alias from ~/.ssh/config. Without the Hetzner API, add ipv4 / city / lat / lon / type / price_eur yourself. Optional: jump = ssh alias of the jump host this server is reached through (all hops then share one connection); via_host + via_key = reach a private-only box through this one (ssh <ssh> 'ssh -i <via_key> <via_host>'); runs = hand-written list of what runs on the box; no_backups_ok = true silences the backups finding. links = arrows for the connection diagram; 'you' = the machine running the dashboard.
